title: Diagnostic safety and equipment familiarization
learningObjective: Demonstrate tool selection, isolation and safe measurement setup

equipment.label: Digital multimeter (simulated)
equipment.notes: Reused approved asset. Displays only the measurement supplied by this lab package and never generates its own reading.

equipment.label: OBD-II scan tool panel (simulated)
equipment.notes: Reused approved asset. No scan payload is supplied in Week 1, so the panel shows its explicit not-supplied state; that empty state is the teaching point.

equipment.label: Automotive oscilloscope (simulated)
equipment.notes: Reused approved asset. Week 1 supplies qualitative descriptors only; no sampled trace is plotted and no numeric waveform is implied.

points: Treat every supplied voltage as live. Select the meter function before connecting any lead.
Never place the meter in a current or resistance function across a simulated live supply; state the correct function first.
Confirm the simulated bay state before each step and report an unsafe or ambiguous step instead of continuing.
Isolate the circuit under test in the simulated model before describing any resistance or continuity check.
safetyBriefing.boundaries: This is a simulated training bay. No physical vehicle, tool, or high-voltage procedure is performed. No reading in this lab describes a real vehicle condition, and no manufacturer specification is stated.

instructorDemonstration.summary: Demonstrate function selection, lead placement order, isolation of the circuit under test, and how an unsupplied instrument reports its empty state.
steps: Show the meter with no measurement supplied and read the empty state aloud.
Select the DC voltage function and explain why function selection precedes connection.
Connect the negative lead to the simulated ground point first, then the positive lead, narrating the isolation check.
Open the scan-tool panel with no payload and explain that 'no data supplied' is not the same as 'no fault found'.
Describe how a qualitative oscilloscope observation would be written in words rather than drawn as a trace.

scenario.symptom: Simulated bay familiarization: instruments are powered and connected, but no vehicle measurement has been supplied to any instrument yet.
scenario.systemContext: Familiarization and safety only. Students practise selecting the correct instrument and function, isolating the circuit under test, and reading explicit empty states before any diagnostic scenario is introduced.

measurements.label: Illustrative supply voltage at the simulated battery terminals
measurements.testPoint: simulated battery positive to simulated battery negative
measurements.conditions: simulated key on, engine off, no load applied
measurements.limitations: Illustrative training value authored for this exercise. Not a measurement of any vehicle and not a manufacturer specification.

descriptors: No sampled trace is supplied in Week 1.
Students describe in words what a steady DC level would look like and what would have to change before a scope trace would be useful.
waveformEvidence.notes: Qualitative descriptors only. The runtime renders these as text and plots nothing.

scenario.uncertainty: Students must state which values are illustrative training inputs, and must state what the empty instrument states do and do not prove.

competingHypotheses.statement: The instruments are functioning and simply have no data supplied yet, so nothing can be concluded about the vehicle.
evidenceFor: Each instrument reports an explicit not-supplied state rather than a value.
evidenceAgainst: A not-supplied state would look identical if an instrument were faulty, so the state alone is not proof of correct operation.

competingHypotheses.statement: A connection or setup fault is preventing a measurement from reaching the instrument.
evidenceFor: No reading appears on the meter until a measurement is explicitly supplied to it.
evidenceAgainst: The supplied illustrative voltage does appear once requested, which shows the display path works.

testSelectionOptions.label: Confirm the meter function and isolation before connecting leads
testSelectionOptions.justificationPrompt: Explain why function selection and isolation precede connection, and what could go wrong if the order were reversed.
testSelectionOptions.expectedObservation: The display shows the selected function with no value until a measurement is supplied.

testSelectionOptions.label: Open the scan tool and read the not-supplied state
testSelectionOptions.justificationPrompt: Explain what the empty scan-tool state does and does not prove about the vehicle.
testSelectionOptions.expectedObservation: The panel states that no data has been supplied.

testSelectionOptions.label: State how a scope observation would be recorded without a trace
testSelectionOptions.justificationPrompt: Explain how to record a waveform observation in words when no sampled trace is available.
testSelectionOptions.expectedObservation: A written description of the expected shape and what evidence would be needed to confirm it.

prompts: Which instrument and function did you select first, and why did that order matter?
What did each instrument display before any data was supplied, and what does that state not prove?
Which values in this lab are illustrative training inputs rather than verified measurements?
What would you report to an instructor before continuing to a live diagnostic scenario?

steps: Re-select the instrument function and re-request the supplied reading under the same stated conditions.
Confirm the empty-state message returns when the supplied measurement is removed.
expectedEvidence: A repeated reading with identical conditions and an unchanged provenance label.
A stated explanation that repeating a reading does not by itself verify a repair.

accessibility.keyboardPath: Tab from the skip link through the session plan, then use Enter or Space to activate instrument controls and test-selection buttons.
textAlternatives: Every supplied reading is rendered as text with its unit, conditions, provenance and limitations.
Qualitative waveform descriptors are text; no meaning depends on a plotted trace.
notes: Status changes are announced through a polite live region.
Motion in the reused assets is decorative and is disabled under prefers-reduced-motion.
Layout is responsive; the measurement table scrolls rather than clipping.

technicalReviewChecklist.statement: Safety brief states simulated-only scope and requires no physical procedure.
Every supplied reading carries units, conditions, provenance and limitations.
No manufacturer specification, service limit or verified waveform claim appears.
Keyboard path and text alternatives are accurate for the built page.
Instructor material is stored outside the student tree and is not reachable from this page.
